title: Sign in
intro: Sign in with your Aquarium account to open your agent home.
noProvider: No password provider is configured on the AI layer. OAuth sign-in via the bridge is deferred to a later wave.
resetIntro: Enter your email and an administrator of your profile will be given a one-time link to hand over.
resetSent: If that address is enrolled here, an administrator now has a link for it.
suspended: Your access to every profile you're in has been suspended. Ask an administrator to restore it.
noPrincipal: You signed in, but you aren't a member of any profile here yet. Ask an administrator to add you.
noAccount: No account? Ask the owner for an invite link.
